name: LangSmith
oneLine: LangChain's hosted platform for tracing, evaluating and deploying LLM applications; self-hosting is an Enterprise add-on.

selfHostStack.value: Enterprise add-on, Kubernetes/Helm: app services, ClickHouse (or SmithDB), PostgreSQL, Redis/Valkey, blob storage

selfHostLicence.value: Proprietary: self-hosting needs an Enterprise plan and a licence key

cloudFree.value: Developer: $0, 1 seat, 5k base traces/month, community support; base traces kept 14 days

cloudPaidFrom.value: Plus: $39 per seat per month, up to 10k base traces/month, then pay as you go

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP at <api-url>/otel; no gRPC endpoint documented; maps gen_ai.*, OpenInference, TraceLoop, Logfire

sql.value: Not documented: docs describe a filter query language, SDK and REST API queries

mcp.value: Hosted Remote MCP (OAuth or API key): runs, threads, prompts, datasets, experiments, billing usage

onlineEvals.value: Yes: online evaluations on production traces, including LLM-as-a-judge evaluators with weekly cost caps

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: datasets built from examples, production traces or synthetic data, and experiments

promptManagement.value: Yes: Prompt and Context Hub with commits and tags

gateway.value: LLM Gateway (beta): routes model calls with tracing, fallbacks, spend and rate limits

alerts.value: Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace and webhooks; email only via a webhook recipe

issueDetection.value: Insights reports group up to 1,000 sampled traces into auto-generated categories; Plus and Enterprise plans

annotationQueues.value: Queues of runs or threads; assign named reviewers or a reviewer count; a reservation locks an item to one reviewer

assistant.value: LangSmith Chat (formerly Polly): asks over traces, threads, prompts and experiments; needs a model provider key

codingAgents.value: Tracing guides for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, OpenCode and Pi

chooseThem: First-party tracing for LangChain and LangGraph, with a managed cloud and no infrastructure to run
Evaluation, online evaluators and agent deployment in one hosted product
Enterprise options: self-hosted, hybrid, custom SSO, RBAC and a support SLA
Cloud data location in US or EU, with a free single-seat Developer tier
notes: Per-trace overage price not on pricing page read; not stated. Retention: base 14 days, extended 180 days.
